description: Writes a message into a client conversation's draft box. It never sends: a person on the team reviews the exact text and presses Send in Sergio, where the organization's sending policy applies. Give conversationId, or clientId to use that client's conversation. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the original draft.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: create_draft
title: Draft a message
